# namespace_registry_image (Data Source)

Reads details and digest for a single container image in the Namespace registry by tag or sha256 digest.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_registry_image" "app" {
  repository = "backend-service"
  reference  = "v1.4.2"
}

output "image_digest" {
  value = data.namespace_registry_image.app.digest
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reference` (String) Tag (e.g. `v1.2.0`) or digest (e.g. `sha256:...`) reference for the image.
- `repository` (String) Name of the container registry repository.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `digest` (String) Authoritative sha256 content digest for the image.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 expiration timestamp, if configured.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier formatted as `<repository>@<digest>`.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Total size of the image in bytes.
- `tags` (List of String) List of all tags pointing to this image digest, sorted alphabetically.
